response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON CAST(f.orderslink AS text) = CAST(o.recordvault AS text)), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) AS rate FROM matched), pair_rates AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) AS rate FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(p.rate) AS average_pair_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.rate - b.rate) AS average_excess_over_benchmark FROM pair_rates AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.rate IS NOT NULL AND p.rate > b.rate;
